import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode
random.seed(11)
N_TYPES=8000; N_MODULES=4096; N_ENTRIES=32; N_EDGES=16000
N_RUNS=2048; ARR=64; NPARAMS=16; N_STATES=4096; N_TRANS=16000
types=[{"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},{"name":"I32","kind":"int","bits":32},
       {"name":"Byte","kind":"int","bits":8},{"name":"Str","kind":"string","maxsize":16}]
for i in range(N_TYPES):
    k=i%4
    if k==0: types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"alias","target":"I32"})
    elif k==1: types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"struct","fields":[["f","I32"],["g","Byte"]]})
    elif k==2: types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"array","element":"Byte","size":2})
    else: types.append({"name":"T%d"%i,"kind":"enum","values":["v0","v1","v2"]})
types.append({"name":"Arr","kind":"array","element":"I32","size":ARR})
types.append({"name":"St","kind":"enum","values":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)]})
modules=[]
for e in range(N_ENTRIES):
    modules.append({"name":"e%02d"%e,
      "params":[["p%02d"%j,"Arr"] for j in range(NPARAMS)]+[["st","St"],["msg","Str"]],
      "result":["r","Bool"],
      "requires":["and",["all","x",["var","p00"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","I32",1<<30]]],
                  ["match",["var","msg"],"[a-z0-9]*"]]})
for i in range(N_MODULES-N_ENTRIES):
    modules.append({"name":"h%05d"%i,"params":[["q","T%d"%((i*4)%N_TYPES)]],
                    "result":["hr","Bool"],"requires":None})
names=[m["name"] for m in modules]
calls=[]
for i in range(N_EDGES):
    a=random.randrange(N_ENTRIES); b=random.randrange(N_ENTRIES,N_MODULES)
    calls.append(["e%02d"%a,names[b]])
machine={"states":["s%d"%i for i in range(N_STATES)],"initial":"s0",
         "state_param":"st","message_param":"msg","transitions":[]}
for i in range(N_STATES-1):
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%i,"to":"s%d"%(i+1),
        "command":"step%05d"%i,"cost":1,"when":None})
for i in range(N_TRANS-(N_STATES-1)):
    src=random.randrange(N_STATES); dst=random.randrange(N_STATES)
    machine["transitions"].append({"from":"s%d"%src,"to":"s%d"%dst,"command":"c%06d"%i,
        "cost":1+random.randrange(1000),
        "when":None if i%8 else ["lt",["const","I32",i%5],["const","I32",3]]})
camp={"types":types,"modules":modules,"calls":calls,"pipes":[],
      "entries":["e%02d"%e for e in range(N_ENTRIES)],"machine":machine,"runs":[]}
byname={m["name"]:m for m in modules}
runs=[]
total_objects=0
for r in range(N_RUNS):
    e=r%N_ENTRIES; m=byname["e%02d"%e]
    params={"p%02d"%j:[(j*7919+k*104729)%(1<<30) for k in range(ARR)] for j in range(NPARAMS)}
    params["st"]="s%d"%random.randrange(N_STATES)
    params["msg"]=([ord(c) for c in "m%d"%r]+[0]*16)[:16]
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,params,True)
    total_objects+=len(objs)
    runs.append({"entry":"e%02d"%e,"ktest":kit.encode(objs)})
camp["runs"]=runs
data=json.dumps(camp)
print("input %.1f MiB, objects total %d, ids per entry %d"%(len(data)/1048576.,total_objects,n))
open('/workspace/tmp/max.json','w').write(data)
t=time.time(); out=kit.run(camp); print("full run %.1fs"%(time.time()-t))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x["status"] for x in out["records"]))
print("corpus",len(out["corpus"]),"slots",sum(len(p["slots"]) for p in out["plans"]),
      "vars",sum(p["variables"] for p in out["plans"]))
print("cmds total",sum(len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"]))
PYEOF
time python3 /tmp/max.py
